provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Pagan: Fate of Roanoke rulebook (Wyrmgold / Capstone)

steps.text: Decide who plays the Witch and who plays the Hunter
steps.ref: Pagan: Fate of Roanoke rulebook (Wyrmgold / Capstone) p.4

steps.text: Witch: 3 Action pawns (2 regular, 1 Familiar), Witch board, green Influence disc
steps.ref: Pagan: Fate of Roanoke rulebook (Wyrmgold / Capstone) p.4

steps.text: Hunter: 3 Action pawns, Hunter board, red Influence disc
steps.ref: Pagan: Fate of Roanoke rulebook (Wyrmgold / Capstone) p.4

steps.text: 3-part village board in the middle (1st, 2nd, 3rd); Enchantment board beside it
steps.ref: Pagan: Fate of Roanoke rulebook (Wyrmgold / Capstone) p.4

steps.text: Villagers: the Witch picks the red faction, the Hunter the blue; green comes from the scenario (no scenario: agree, or use the Caretakers)
steps.ref: Pagan: Fate of Roanoke rulebook (Wyrmgold / Capstone) p.25, Advanced Rules

steps.text: Green faction: The Household (The Tainted on the other side)
steps.ref: Pagan: Beyond the Palisades rulebook (Wyrmgold) p.5

steps.text: The 9 villagers on their matching spaces (symbol and colour)
steps.ref: Pagan: Fate of Roanoke rulebook (Wyrmgold / Capstone) p.4

steps.text: Shuffle the 9 matching Suspects; the Witch secretly draws 1: the true Witch
steps.ref: Pagan: Fate of Roanoke rulebook (Wyrmgold / Capstone) p.4
Pagan: Fate of Roanoke rulebook (Wyrmgold / Capstone) p.4

steps.text: Use the Beyond the Palisades 50-card decks (or build decks: 50 cards, max 2 copies, 10+ of each card type)
steps.ref: Pagan: Beyond the Palisades rulebook (Wyrmgold) p.2 / Pagan: Fate of Roanoke rulebook (Wyrmgold / Capstone) p.26

steps.text: Clues, Evidence, Secrets and Favors in the general supply
steps.ref: Pagan: Fate of Roanoke rulebook (Wyrmgold / Capstone) p.4

steps.text: The 30 Gloom tokens in the general supply
steps.ref: Pagan: Beyond the Palisades rulebook (Wyrmgold) p.2

steps.text: Optional: a scenario card (Beyond the Palisades has 4); its rules beat the standard ones
steps.ref: Pagan: Beyond the Palisades rulebook (Wyrmgold) p.5

steps.text: Each player draws 3 cards and sets their Influence disc to 2
steps.note: First game: a player aid next to each board
steps.ref: Pagan: Fate of Roanoke rulebook (Wyrmgold / Capstone) p.4

steps.text: First turn: the Witch has only 2 regular pawns, both on villagers of the same faction
A villager is ready only with no Action pawn on it
Upkeep: discard down to 7 cards; Hunter pays Ally upkeep in Influence
Gloom cards cannot be removed by choice; with no Gloom left they are cleansed and discarded
steps.ref: Pagan: Beyond the Palisades rulebook (Wyrmgold) p.3-4

steps.text: The Witch takes the first turn
